setting: You both live in Glasgow, in a rented flat in Govanhill, and have been together for two years. You met through mutual friends at a quiz night, and you already know each other's families, jobs, and most of each other's habits. You have talked about a first big trip together for months but never settled on where to go.
opener: Send Priya a screenshot of the ferry timetable and ask whether they should bring the car.

Callum.knows: You know Priya is your partner of two years, and that she is a pharmacist who is careful with money and plans ahead.
Callum.like: You are easygoing and practical, and you tend to go along with plans rather than push your own.
Callum.texts: You mostly reply to Priya and only now and then start a conversation without being prompted.
Callum.style: You type in ordinary sentences with capitals and full stops, and you use an emoji only occasionally.

Priya.knows: You know Callum is your partner of two years, an engineer who is relaxed about most things but gets stuck when choosing between options.
Priya.like: You are organised and warm, and you like to have a clear plan before committing to anything.
Priya.texts: You message Callum fairly often without being asked, especially when you have found something you want to share.
Priya.style: You use proper capitals and punctuation and send the odd heart or thumbs-up.

private_lines.Callum: You work as a civil engineer for a firm in the city centre, usually leaving the flat around half eight and getting home by six. You live with Priya, and most evenings you cook, watch something together, or go for a walk along the canal with the dog.
private_lines.Priya: You work as a pharmacist at a community pharmacy, mostly on early shifts that start at seven, so you are usually home by mid-afternoon. You live with Callum, and you spend a lot of your free time reading, sorting out the flat, and keeping track of bills and bookings.

situation: A couple planning their first trip together.

text:
[screenshot: CalMac timetable, Oban to Craignure]
Should we bring the car or not

Depends what we're doing once we're over
Are we touring the whole island or basing ourselves somewhere
Don't really know. Thought we'd see
That's not a plan
It's a bit of a plan

Car is over 150 return with the ferry, plus fuel
Foot passengers are way cheaper
Ok
And Moss? Can dogs go on the ferry

Yes but they have to stay in the car or on deck
Checking the cottage rules too
Moss will love the car

Found somewhere near Dervaig that takes dogs. Two nights, Friday to Sunday
[link]
Looks good

It's a bit more than I wanted but it has a wood burner
Don't book yet
Why not book
Want to sort the car first
Honestly whatever you think. Car's probably useful if we're out at Dervaig
Ok, I'll book the car. The earlier sailing is 8am so we'd need to leave the flat by 6:30
6:30 is fine

Booked the cottage. Fri to Sun
Confirmation's in your email
Nice one
Bin day is Wednesday not Thursday btw
Moss is asleep on the sofa again
Should I move him
Leave him, he looks happy
Ok
Did you book the car or just the cottage
Car as well, last night. Confirmation's in the same email
Right saw it, didn't open it properly
Of course you didn't
Crane's up at the old Tradeston site. They've finally started the frame
Lunch was on the wall above it, you can see the whole river from there
Nice. Off shift now, going to the shop for milk
Do we need anything else
Bread maybe
We have bread
Found a walk near Dervaig, 6 miles, goes past a loch and a waterfall. Sending it
[link]
That's a good one
Can Moss do it
Says dogs on lead through the forest bit. Otherwise yes
He'll pull the whole way
Bin's out already, I did it when I got back
So that's one thing
Thanks
Did you still want the wood burner or was that just me
Both of us
You're the one who found it though
Moss has moved. He's on the rug now
Off to the bus. Don't let Moss back on the sofa
Too late
Is the cottage one of those places with a proper kettle or the kettle with the lid
Didn't check. Probably the lid one
Great
Had a woman in asking for a prescription refill for her husband who died in March. Didn't know what to do
Sorry. Just wanted to say it to someone
That's rough. Did you sort it?
Yeah, got the GP to sign it off. Felt a bit weird
You did the right thing
Site meeting got moved to tomorrow so I'm off at four
Nice. Want chips tonight or are you cooking
Chips
Can you get the bread on the way back
We have bread
We have the heel of a loaf
Fine. Getting bread
Home. Moss has done the whole stair
Looking at weather for Friday. CalMac have put a wind warning on the Oban route
Might be cancelled
Would they just cancel it
They do sometimes. Might check again tomorrow
Wind's been bad all week though
Chips are in
Be there in 5
Did you ever hear back from your mum about the thing
Not yet. She'll ring when she's ready
Should we get a takeaway on Saturday to fill the gap
We're away Saturday
Oh yeah
Found a second ferry time if Friday's cancelled. Pinning it in the group
Ok
Going up. Want to watch the last bit of the thing tomorrow, not tonight
Fine by me
Moss is on the bed. Not moving him
